rationale: After direct inspection of printed pages 784, 785, and 793 and full expansion of D001-D055, the target is the exact no-guard recursive running-error bound (5.3). Its model has the correct per-operation existential perturbations, its recursion computes the listed-order prefixes with hat S_1=x_1, and its budget has exactly the required k=2,...,n terms. Both implication directions hold, the hypotheses are satisfiable, and a two-term admitted model can attain equality. The unbound i in printed (5.2), direct abstraction of no-underflow into the model law, and total n=0 edge case do not alter the selected conclusion.
